name: Benzocaine
aliases: 4-aminobenzoic acid ethyl ester, Amben ethyl ester, Americaine, Baby Anbesol, Benzocaina, Benzocainum, ethyl 4-aminobenzoate, Ethyl Aminobenzoate
summary: Benzocaine, sold under the brand name Orajel amongst others, is a local anesthetic, belonging to the amino ester drug class, commonly used as a topical painkiller or in cough drops. It is the active ingredient in many over-the-counter anesthetic ointments such as products for oral ulcers. It is combined with antipyrine to form A/B ear drops.

uses.text: Benzocaine, sold under the brand name Orajel amongst others, is a local anesthetic, belonging to the amino ester drug class, commonly used as a topical painkiller or in cough drops. It is the active ingredient in many over-the-counter anesthetic ointments such as products for oral ulcers. It was first synthesised in 1890 in Germany and approved for medical use in 1902.

sideEffects.text: Benzocaine is generally well tolerated and non-toxic when applied topically as recommended. However, there have been reports of serious, life-threatening adverse effects (e.g., seizures, coma, irregular heart beat, respiratory depression) with over-application of topical products or when applying topical products that contain high concentrations of benzocaine to the skin.

summaryZh: 苯佐卡因，又稱「阿奈斯台辛」，學名對氨基苯甲酸乙酯。

pharmacology.en: Like other local anaesthetics, it blocks the sodium channels that nerve cells use to fire. With those channels shut the nerve cannot pass a pain signal along, so the surface goes numb.
pharmacology.zh: 和其他局部麻醉劑一樣，它阻斷神經細胞放電所用的鈉離子通道。通道關閉後，神經無法傳遞疼痛訊號，表面便失去感覺。
pharmacology.zhHans: 和其他局部麻醉剂一样，它阻断神经细胞放电所用的钠离子信道。信道关闭后，神经无法传递疼痛信号，表面便失去感觉。

fact.en: Benzocaine was made in 1890 by the German chemist Eduard Ritsert and is still the numbing agent in teething gels and throat lozenges. It is also widely used as a cutting agent in street cocaine because it numbs the gums in the same way.
fact.zh: 苯佐卡因由德國化學家 Eduard Ritsert 於 1890 年合成，至今仍是長牙凝膠與喉糖中的麻醉成分。它也常被用作街頭古柯鹼的摻雜物，因為它同樣能使牙齦麻木。
fact.zhHans: 苯佐卡因由德国化学家 Eduard Ritsert 于 1890 年合成，至今仍是长牙凝胶与喉糖中的麻醉成分。它也常被用作街头古柯碱的掺杂物，因为它同样能使牙龈麻木。
